description_en: Import outbound call callee numbers based on the instance ID and job ID.
description_zh: 根据实例ID、任务ID导入外呼被叫号码
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs insert-ai-outbound-phone-nums --instance-id agent_000 --task-id 123 --batch-version 2 --details BizData=xxxx PhoneNum=15000000000 --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InsertAiOutboundPhoneNums

parameters.help_en:
The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.  
You can obtain it from **Instance Management** in the left-side navigation pane of the [Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在[智能联络中心控制台](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The job ID.  

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html API and check the **Data** field in the response, or invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html API and check the **TaskId** field in the response.
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html接口，查看返回参数中的**Data**，或者调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html接口，查看返回参数中的**TaskId**
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The batch version number of the job.  

> If this parameter is not specified, numbers are imported into the default batch.
parameters.help_zh:
任务批次号。

> 不填则导入到默认批次
parameters.name: batch_version

element_fields.help_en: The callee number for outbound calls.
element_fields.name: phone_num

parameters.help_en:
Number details.  
> A maximum of 30 entries are allowed.
parameters.name: details
